entries.subject: Source-backed global ultraviolet cloud map to replace the illustrative cloud texture
entries.finding: The default cloud lens is still the OpenSpace project's Venus cloud texture, an illustrative map with unresolved camera, wavelength and colour processing. No archive publishes a source-backed multi-orbit global cylindrical UV cloud map: JAXA DARTS ships Akatsuki UVI Level-3 products (vco_uvi_l3, DOI 10.17597/isas.darts/vco-00016, CC BY 4.0) only as per-image 0.125-degree longitude-latitude grids in NetCDF-4, each covering the sunlit disc of one exposure, and ESA's VMC mosaic is a northern-hemisphere press strip. A replacement therefore needs a preparation step that composites several 365 nm L3b grids across one four-day cloud rotation, normalised for incidence, which this repository does not have.
entries.revisitWhen: An Akatsuki UVI L3b compositing route (NetCDF-4 reader, per-pixel incidence and emission selection across one cloud rotation, stated epoch) or a published global UV cloud mosaic with grid metadata and a permissive licence would reopen the cloud lens.
